attchmntText: Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about The conference call, earlier scheduled for 11:30 A.M. (IST), will now be conducted at 12:30 P.M. (IST) on Thursday, 12th November, 2026.
voiceSummary: Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited has revised the timing of its conference call to discuss financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30.09.2026. The call is now scheduled for 12:30 P.M. IST on Thursday, 12th November, 2026. The previous time was 11:30 A.M. The event is hosted by Antique Stock Broking Limited. Management representatives include Smt. Avantika Singh, Mr. G S Paliwal, Mr. S S Bhatt, Mr. Vrajesh Parikh, and Mr. Shailesh Damani. Dial-in numbers are provided for domestic and international participants. Details are available on the company website at www.gacl.com. The invite is subject to change due to exigency.

attchmntText: Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited has uploaded an updated Investors Presentation to its website. The document is available at the URL https://gacl.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Investor-presentation_Sep-2026.pdf. This update is intended for the benefit of investors and shareholders. The announcement was issued on 7th November 2026. It was signed by S S Bhatt, Company Secretary and Executive Director. The company code for BSE is 530001. The company code for NSE is GUJALKALI.

attchmntText: Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet. We would like to inform you that Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited has schedule a conference call to discuss the financial result of the Company for quarter and half year ended on 30.09.2026 for analyst and investors on Thursday, 12.11.2026 at 11:30 a.m. IST.

Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication  of the extract of Standalone & Consolidated Un- audited (Provisional) Financial Results for the Second Quarter and Half Year ended 30th September, 2026.

Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of  Shri Brijesh Patel as General Manager (Research & Development) with effect from 6th November, 2026. For more details kindly refer attached file.

Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 05, 2026, titled "Press release dated 05.11.2026, titled "Press Note on Financial Results as on 30.09.2026. For more details kindly refer attached file.".
Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.

Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates. We would like to inform that out of total capacity of 75.9 MW (Phase-1: 16.5 MW and Phase-2: 59.4 MW) of Clean Max Renewable Hybrid Power Project, 6.6 MW Hybrid Power installation (Out of Phase-1: 16.5 MW) has been made operative today. For more details kindly refer attached file.
Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Trading Window closure pursuant to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015

Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates: Ground-Breaking ceremony of 33,870 TPA Food Grade Phosphoric Acid plant PPA-II facility at Dahej.  For more information kindly refer attached file
Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication. Notice for Special Window for Transfer and Demat of Physical Securities.
